Title: Integrate Azure Stream Analytics with Azure Machine Learning (in preview)

Body.Content:
Implement machine learning models as a user-defined function (UDF) in your Azure Stream Analytics jobs to do real-time scoring and predictions on your streaming input data. Use any popular open-source tool, such as Tensorflow, scikit-learn, or PyTorch, to prep, train, and deploy models with Azure Machine Learning.

Read more details.
